9. The Sulfurous Ghost
As oxygen levels in the ocean plummet, scientists are seeing the return of a condition that once characterized the "Great Dying" of the Permian era. When water becomes both anoxic and rich in hydrogen sulfide, it creates a toxic environment that is hostile to almost all complex life. This state of the ocean is named after the geochemist who first proposed its historical existence. What is the term for this oxygen-starved, prehistoric ocean state?
